Xtracover 1 Year Extended Warranty on Smartphone Having Price Range of Rs. 100001-125000 (E-Mail Delivery Only)
from Xtracover ₹6,229.00
  • Peace of mind : Protect Your device today against any manufacturing defects, which could cost you 50-60% of the product price to repair. Also get convenience of doorstep pickup and repairs service.
  • The plan will start after the Brand warranty ends & will be active for next 1 Year. Only valid if purchased for a new device with a valid Brand / Manufacturing warranty. Not valid for renewed / refurbished products.
  • Service contract is email delivered and auto-activated if purchased for branded devices in Amazon. After ordering, for plan-related details, check 'Buyer/Seller messages' under Message Center at "amazon.in/msg" or check your Amazon regd email ID.
  • What’s included and What’s excluded: All labor, spare parts, & transportation charges for repairing the mechanical defects & electric malfunctions of the device will be covered as per the extended warranty. The plan does not cover Accidental or Liquid damages, Damage caused by unauthorized repairs, Accessories, Consumables, or parts that are not covered under the standard Brand warranty.
  • To claim call 8860396039 or write to contactus@xtracover.com or go to Amazon app >> Your Orders Section >> Find your Product order >> Click on “Get Product Support” > Schedule a service.

      About this item

      • Pocket-Perfect AI - Introducing our thinnest and most advanced Galaxy Z Flip ever - with next-gen Galaxy AI, unparalleled beauty and performance that seamlessly fits your lifestyle and your pocket.
      • Ultra sleek - The ultra pocketable Galaxy Z Flip7 has a re-designed cover screen display that features our slimmest bezel yet, enabling you to do more from the FlexWindow than ever before. And, with the all-new One UI 8, get the most personalised UI for the cover screen and the main screen, too.
      • Thinnest Yet Strong - The strong and light Armor Aluminium frame with an innovative Armor FlexHinge closes thinner and protects your device. And, with Knox vault, your privacy is completely secured with on-device protection.
      • 50MP Camera - Powered by next-gen ProVisual Engine, now enjoy richer, more detailed selfies that you can preview on larger FlexWindow of the all-new Galaxy Z Flip7.
      • 4300mAh Larger Battery - Our larger 4300 mAh battery has been optimised by the powerful processor so this Flip is ready for hours of uninterrupted entertainment. Now, get things done comfortably including hassle free payments on Samsung Wallet.

            About this Item

            • Pocket-Perfect AI - Introducing our thinnest and most advanced Galaxy Z Flip ever - with next-gen Galaxy AI, unparalleled beauty and performance that seamlessly fits your lifestyle and your pocket.
            • Ultra sleek - The ultra pocketable Galaxy Z Flip7 has a re-designed cover screen display that features our slimmest bezel yet, enabling you to do more from the FlexWindow than ever before. And, with the all-new One UI 8, get the most personalised UI for the cover screen and the main screen, too.
            • Thinnest Yet Strong - The strong and light Armor Aluminium frame with an innovative Armor FlexHinge closes thinner and protects your device. And, with Knox vault, your privacy is completely secured with on-device protection.
            • 50MP Camera - Powered by next-gen ProVisual Engine, now enjoy richer, more detailed selfies that you can preview on larger FlexWindow of the all-new Galaxy Z Flip7.
            • 4300mAh Larger Battery - Our larger 4300 mAh battery has been optimised by the powerful processor so this Flip is ready for hours of uninterrupted entertainment. Now, get things done comfortably including hassle free payments on Samsung Wallet.

            Product description

            POCKET-PERFECT AI - Introducing our thinnest and most advanced Galaxy Z Flip ever - unparalleled beauty and performance that seamlessly fits your lifestyle and your pocket. | ULTRA SLEEK, ULTRA POCKETABLE - Galaxy Z Flip7's redesigned cover screen features our slimmest bezel yet, enabling you to do more from the Flex Window than ever before. | THINNEST YET STRONG - The strong and light Armor Aluminium frame with an innovative Armor Flex Hinge closes thinner and protects your device. | 50MP OUTSTANDING CAMERA - Powered by next-gen ProVisual Engine, now enjoy richer, more detailed selfies that you can preview on larger Flex Window of the all-new Galaxy Z Flip7. | LARGEST BATTERY ON GALLERY Z FLIP - Our larger 4300 mAh battery has been optimised by our powerful processor so this Flip is ready for hours of uninterrupted entertainment.
